title: Multiplexer Module - Band 26 (850 MHz) for Public Safety Band Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Olaf Bergstrom

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a Multiplexer Module filter targeting Band 26 (850 MHz) for Public Safety Band Filter. The filter is designed on AlN on Si substrate with a target center frequency of 2325.0 MHz and bandwidth of 297.1 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the Public Safety Band Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: Multiplexer Module
- Frequency Band: Band 26 (850 MHz)
- Application: Public Safety Band Filter
- Substrate: AlN on Si
- Package: WLP (Wafer Level Package)
- Design Tool: Cadence AWR Microwave Office
- Design Center: San Jose Advanced Design Lab

This specification applies to all variants of the Multiplexer Module design targeting Band 26 (850 MHz). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       2325.0 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       297.1 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 1.2 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 14.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 42.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 44.0 dB
Q Factor:               12978
Temperature Coefficient:-26.5 ppm/°C
Die Size:               0.6 x 1.9 mm
Wafer Size:             6-inch
Number of Resonators:   3
Electrode Material:     Mo
Passivation:            Si3N4
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Cadence AWR Microwave Office and load the Multiplexer Module template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: AlN on Si with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 2325.0 MHz, BW 297.1 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 1.2 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (WLP (Wafer Level Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (6-inch, AlN on Si).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Keysight N5227B PNA.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 6975 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 1.2 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 14.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 446 MHz offset >= 42.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 5 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 7.7 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +33 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 2000 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 97%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2025-06-07
Devices Tested:         79
Insertion Loss (meas):  0.87 dB
Return Loss (meas):     16.5 dB
Rejection (meas):       44.9 dB
Isolation (meas):       48.9 dB
Q Factor (meas):        12978
Group Delay Variation:  3.7 ns
Power Handling:         +31 dBm
Die Yield:              85.5%

Result Classification:  PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Multiplexer Module design demonstrated excellent performance for Band 26 (850 MHz).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Temperature stability was within specification across full range.
e) ESD robustness exceeded specification by 2x margin.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS: No corrective actions required. Design passed all acceptance criteria.
